_sources: provisions: 1961 s.74 / 2025 s.111 (coverage MODELLED, D-247). summary: S2 s.111(1), (2) (Gazette 265620 p.148), s.536(2)(n) (p.493); 1961 s.74(1), (2) (thc p.325). routes[0]: SETOFF-CARRIED-CAPITAL-GAINS (TaxYearSpan; the order declared, D-247). disqualifiers[0]: s.121 / s.80, the return condition, enforced by the same row (CarriedCapitalLoss.determinedInReturnFiledInTime). disqualifiers[1]: s.111(1)(a)(ii) / s.74(1)(b), a long-term loss against long-term gains only.
summary: A capital loss not set off in the year it arose is carried to later years and set only against capital gains, for a limited number of years, after which it lapses. A short-term loss may be set against any capital gain; a long-term loss only against long-term gains.

routes.name: The carried loss against later capital gains
routes.description: The oldest year's loss is used first, its long-term part before its short-term; the order is stated, because the law does not fix one.

disqualifiers.description: A loss not worked out in a return filed in time is not carried forward.
A long-term loss cannot be set against short-term gains.
